defectsCorrected.title: 25/25 rooms scoring RECOMMENDED
defectsCorrected.rootCause: recommended was a binary derivation: recommended = !semantic.rejectedByDefault && eligibility.eligible, collapsing eligible==recommended so every non-rejected, geometrically usable room became RECOMMENDED.
defectsCorrected.fix: Introduced explicit CandidateTier (RECOMMENDED/SUITABLE/NEEDS_REVIEW/REJECTED) via resolveCandidateTier() using data-driven blended-score bands (no fixed quota). recommended is now derived as (tier === 'RECOMMENDED'). UNKNOWN and GENERIC_OCCUPIABLE are capped below RECOMMENDED.

defectsCorrected.title: '1DC1 WAITING / ACTIVITY AREA' scoring 100% suitability
defectsCorrected.rootCause: The token 'waiting' was classified as ENCLOSED_ROOM, and scoreClinicalSuitability(ENCLOSED_ROOM) returned 1.0, so a waiting/activity area earned full clinical-suitability confidence.
defectsCorrected.fix: Added a GENERIC_OCCUPIABLE semantic kind and moved waiting/activity/lounge/reception/day room/bay/store/storage/bare 'room' into it. GENERIC_OCCUPIABLE scores 0.5 suitability and can never be RECOMMENDED. Dedicated clinical words remain ENCLOSED_ROOM.

defectsCorrected.title: candidate list overflow + preview re-parenting risk
defectsCorrected.rootCause: Candidate results were an unbounded list; actions were hidden until a card was expanded; concern that preview actions could mutate assignment.
defectsCorrected.fix: Candidate results render in a dedicated bounded scrollable region (max-height 320px, overflow-y auto) with compact cards showing tier + suitability% + fit% + area + storey + authority + concise reasons. Fit to Room / Enter Walkthrough Here / Use This Room are always reachable at the bottom of every card. Preview actions (Fit to Room -> fitViewToClinicalRoom; Enter Walkthrough Here -> enterWalkthroughAtClinicalRoom) are inspection-only and never call reparentClinicalFunction. Only Use This Room re-parents, and rejected/ineligible candidates require an explicit override checkbox first.

calibrationModel.nonClinicalCap: UNKNOWN and GENERIC_OCCUPIABLE best tier is SUITABLE; never RECOMMENDED
calibrationModel.hardReject: default-rejected host kind OR degenerate/ineligible geometry => REJECTED
